schema.text: How many traffic lanes must people cross here?
schema.help: A traffic lane is a strip of road for one line of moving vehicles. Bus lanes count, parking spaces do not.

en.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: How many traffic lanes must people cross here?
en.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: A traffic lane is a strip of road for one line of moving vehicles. Bus lanes count, parking spaces do not.

it.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: Quante corsie di traffico devono attraversare le persone qui?
it.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: Una corsia è una fascia di strada per una fila di veicoli in movimento. Le corsie degli autobus contano, i posti auto no.

fr.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: Combien de voies de circulation faut-il traverser ici ?
fr.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: Une voie de circulation est une bande de route pour une file de véhicules en mouvement. Les voies de bus comptent, les places de stationnement non.

de.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: Wie viele Fahrspuren müssen hier überquert werden?
de.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: Eine Fahrspur ist ein Fahrbahnstreifen für eine Reihe fahrender Fahrzeuge. Busspuren zählen mit, Parkplätze nicht.

tr.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: Trafik şeridi, hareket hâlindeki tek sıra araç için ayrılmış yol şerididir. Otobüs şeritleri sayılır, park yerleri sayılmaz.

fa.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: در اینجا چند خط عبور خودرو باید طی شود؟
fa.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: خط عبور نواری از خیابان برای یک ردیف خودروی در حال حرکت است. خط اتوبوس حساب می‌شود، جای پارک نه.

hu.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: Hány forgalmi sávot kell itt keresztezni?
hu.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: A forgalmi sáv az úttest egy sávja egy sor haladó jármű számára. A buszsávok számítanak, a parkolóhelyek nem.

ar.#How many traffic lanes must people cros: كم مسارًا مروريًا يجب عبوره هنا؟
ar.#A traffic lane is a strip of road for o: حارة السير شريط من الطريق لصف واحد من المركبات المتحركة. تُحسب حارات الحافلات، ولا تُحسب أماكن الوقوف.
